units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: At the same time, the Constitution (Fundamental Law) of the Russian Federation — Russia, adopted on 12 April 1978 with subsequent amendments and additions, ceases to have effect.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “At the same time, the Constitution (Fundamental Law) of the…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: If provisions of the Federation Treaty — the Treaty on the Delimitation of Matters of Jurisdiction and Powers between Federal Bodies of State Authority of the Russian Federation and Bodies of State Authority of Sovereign Republics within the Russian Federation; the Treaty on the Delimitation of Matters of Jurisdiction and Powers between Federal Bodies of State Authority of the Russian Federation and Bodies of State Authority of Territories, Regions and the Cities of Moscow and Saint Petersburg of the Russian Federation; and the Treaty on the Delimitation of Matters of Jurisdiction and Powers between Federal Bodies of State Authority of the Russian Federation and Bodies of State Authority of the Autonomous Region and Autonomous Areas within the Russian Federation — or of other treaties between federal bodies of state authority of the Russian Federation and bodies of state authority of its constituent entities, or treaties between bodies of state authority of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, do not conform to provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, the provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation apply.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “If provisions of the Federation Treaty — the Treaty on the…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 2. Laws and other legal acts in force in the territory of the Russian Federation before this Constitution enters into force apply insofar as they do not contradict the Constitution of the Russian Federation.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “2. Laws and other legal acts in force in the territory of the…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 3. From the day this Constitution enters into force, the President of the Russian Federation elected in accordance with the Constitution (Fundamental Law) of the Russian Federation — Russia exercises the powers established by this Constitution until the expiry of the term for which the President was elected.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “3. From the day this Constitution enters into force, the…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 4. From the day this Constitution enters into force, the Council of Ministers — Government of the Russian Federation acquires the rights, duties and responsibilities of the Government of the Russian Federation established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, and henceforth is called the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “4. From the day this Constitution enters into force, the…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 5. Courts in the Russian Federation administer justice in accordance with their powers established by this Constitution.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “5. Courts in the Russian Federation administer justice in…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: After the Constitution enters into force, judges of all courts of the Russian Federation retain their powers until the expiry of the terms for which they were elected. Vacant positions are filled in the manner established by this Constitution.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “After the Constitution enters into force, judges of all courts…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 6. Until a federal law establishing the procedure for courts to hear cases with the participation of jurors is brought into effect, the previous procedure for judicial consideration of the relevant cases is retained.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “6. Until a federal law establishing the procedure for courts to…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: Until the criminal procedural legislation of the Russian Federation is brought into conformity with the provisions of this Constitution, the previous procedure for arrest, custody and detention of persons suspected of committing crimes is retained.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “Until the criminal procedural legislation of the Russian…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 7. The Federation Council of the first convocation and the State Duma of the first convocation are elected for a term of two years.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “7. The Federation Council of the first convocation and the…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 8. The Federation Council meets for its first sitting on the thirtieth day after its election. Its first sitting is opened by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “8. The Federation Council meets for its first sitting on the…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: 9. A deputy of the State Duma of the first convocation may simultaneously be a member of the Government of the Russian Federation. The provisions of this Constitution on deputies' immunity do not apply to deputies of the State Duma who are members of the Government of the Russian Federation insofar as liability for actions (or inaction) connected with the performance of official duties is concerned.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “9. A deputy of the State Duma of the first convocation may…”

units.locator: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
units.text: Deputies of the Federation Council of the first convocation exercise their powers on a non-permanent basis.
units.label: SECTION TWO. FINAL AND TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS · “Deputies of the Federation Council of the first convocation…”
